text:
```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  clang-analyzer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/rsyslog/rsyslog-devcontainer:latest
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang and scan-build
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y clang scan-build

      - name: Configure and build with clang static analyzer
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          scan-build -o scan-build-report make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Upload scan-build report
        id: upload-artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clang-scan-build-report
          path: build/scan-build-report
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Log artifact URL
        run: |
          echo "::notice::Scan-build report available at ${{ steps.upload-artifact.outputs.artifact-url }}"
```
